mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic; fenofibrate can increase serum creatinine and reduce glomerular filtration rate, while gentamicin is renally cleared and accumulates with declining renal function, increasing ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) before and during concurrent use; consider alternative antibiotic if possible; adjust gentamicin dosing based on renal function and therapeutic drug monitoring.
